description: A utility class that provides a wrapper around Android's logging system, allowing chaining of LogNode objects for flexible logging management. It defines log levels, manages a chain of LogNodes, and offers various static methods for logging messages at different levels.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A static utility class for logging, acting as a wrapper and manager for LogNode chains, with predefined log level constants.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which log messages are sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log message output to the current LogNode, passing priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a VERBOSE message, with overloads to include or exclude Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a DEBUG message, with overloads.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an INFO message, with overloads.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a WARN message, with overloads for message and Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an ASSERT (critical) message, with overloads.
